title: Lazar said in 1989 that the craft were intact and the Navy was in charge

tellings.quote: Bob Lazar comes out in 1989 and says they weren't crash saucers, they were intact craft. And it's the Navy that's in charge.

plain: When Bob Lazar went public in 1989 about working on alien craft at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, he is said to have claimed that they were not crashed saucers but intact craft, and that the Navy, not the Air Force, was in charge. The researcher Luigi Vendittelli tells this without naming a source, bringing in the records of Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and the name Eric W. Davis alongside it. The point is that Lazar's details went against the usual story of crash recoveries run by the Air Force.
